description: Burn animated word-by-word captions onto a video with speech, the short-form look for TikTok, Reels and Shorts: the spoken word lights up, placed above the platform buttons. Pass video_url; optional style (pop, highlighter, clean) and highlight_color (#RRGGBB for a brand color). 5 credits.

highlight_color.description: The highlight as #RRGGBB (a brand color) or a name like yellow, green, pink. Defaults to yellow.

style.description: pop (default): bold caps, the spoken word lit and growing. highlighter: the spoken word on a block of the color. clean: sentence case on a dark box.

video_url.description: The video to caption (MP4 or MOV). It must have speech; a silent clip is refused uncharged.

name: pixeldojo_caption
title: Caption video
